The main takeaway from our work is that
the glucocorticoid receptor is an important modulator of L‐PGDS synthesis in neuronal cells, and this is an additional level of control of PG production in the brain.
dexamethazone induces the expression of L‐PGDS, the enzyme responsible for the production and transport of the main PG in neuronal cells, in a time‐ and dose‐dependent manner.
